intent: Let the owner skip a required interview stage if they write why.

edit.summary:
I changed the `skip_stage` action in `SKILL.md` so the owner can skip a required interview stage as well as an optional one, as long as they write a reason. It's still human-only and still needs a non-empty reason. I also added an example, `the-owner-may-skip-a-required-stage-with-a-reason`, to `EXAMPLES.md`.

I only edited the documentation. The `skip_stage` kernel service might still refuse required stages. I couldn't check that, so it needs confirming.
